note: Values that are deliberately identical to English. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check; the checker fails on a missing reason, on an entry that is no longer identical (stale), and when the list grows past 30. An entry with `locales` applies only to those languages — a word can be a genuine cognate in one language and a translation in the other. Anything here that is really an untranslated string must be translated instead.
